statement: SDL 3.2.0 generates the Edge default mapping paddle1:b16,paddle2:b15,paddle3:b14,paddle4:b13. Combined with its PS5 decoder, these address right paddle, left paddle, right function and left function respectively. User mappings can override the default; this is not a capture of the active mapping or a Linux evdev/physical support claim.

applicability.scope: transport detail: SDL HIDAPI; default SDL mapping source
